{{Quote|I am Lelo-Vo and these are my words. I who would not replace the interpreters. Sixteen years debating. The Three screamed. The people begged. Sixteen years but the interpretation was true. Vision cannot be rushed.|Writings of Lelo-Vo|<ref name="Imp March of Time" />}}
'''Lelo-Vo''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] many years before the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. He had a vision that required sixteen years of the [[Interpreter (Voss)|interpreters]] debating, during which time Lelo-Vo refused to replace them. The resulting interpretation was true at the end. Lelo-Vo recorded his thought in the [[Writings of Lelo-Vo]] that were etched on a pillar erected outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]].
